translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the Sichuan Regional Military Commission reported that the Virtue-Praising and other kings had violated the rules, sending envoys with 132 groups of temple monks and no kingly seal documents; only a dozen or so were kept to guard the tribute goods and the rest sent back.

sentences.zh: 禮官言：「番地廣遠，番王亦多，若遵例並時入貢，則內郡疲供億。

translations.literal: Ritual officials said: "Tribal lands are vast and distant and tribal kings are many; if all came to tribute at once according to rule, inner prefectures would be exhausted supplying them.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officials said, "Tribal lands are vast and kings are many; if all came at once under the rule, inner prefectures would be exhausted supplying them.

sentences.zh: 莫若令諸王於應貢之歲，各具印文，取次而來。

translations.literal: Better to have each king in his tribute year bring his seal document and come in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Better to have each king come in turn in his tribute year, each bearing his seal document.

sentences.zh: 今貢使已至，難拂其情。

translations.literal: Now the tribute envoys have already arrived; it is hard to reject their wishes.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys have already arrived; it is hard to turn them away.

sentences.zh: 乞許作明年應貢之數。」

translations.literal: We beg permission to count them as next year's tribute quota.
translations.idiomatic: We ask permission to count them against next year's tribute quota.

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 十八年，禮官言：「番王三歲一貢，貢使百五十人，定制也。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year ritual officials said: "Tribal kings tribute once every three years with one hundred fifty envoys — that is the established rule.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year ritual officials said, "Tribal kings tribute triennially with 150 envoys — that is the established rule.

sentences.zh: 近贊善王連貢者再，已遣四百十三人。

translations.literal: Recently the Virtue-Praising King has twice consecutively sent tribute, already dispatching four hundred thirteen persons.
translations.idiomatic: Recently the Virtue-Praising King had sent tribute twice in succession, already dispatching 413 persons.

sentences.zh: 今請封請襲，又遣千五百五十人，違制宜卻。

translations.literal: Now in requesting enfeoffment and succession he has again sent one thousand five hundred fifty persons; violating the rule he should be refused.
translations.idiomatic: Now, seeking enfeoffment and succession, he has sent 1,550 persons; by the rule he should be refused.

sentences.zh: 乞許其請封襲者，以三百人為後來兩貢之數，余悉遣還。」

translations.literal: We beg to grant his requests for enfeoffment and succession if three hundred persons are counted as two future tribute quotas and the rest are all sent back.
translations.idiomatic: We ask to grant enfeoffment and succession if 300 persons are counted as two future tribute quotas and the rest are sent back.

sentences.zh: 亦報可。

translations.literal: This too was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This too was granted.

sentences.zh: 遂封喃葛堅粲巴藏卜為贊善王。

translations.literal: Nange Jian Can Bazangbu was then enfeoffed Virtue-Praising King.
translations.idiomatic: Nange Jian Can Bazangbu was then enfeoffed Virtue-Praising King.

sentences.zh: 弘治十六年卒，命其弟端竹堅昝嗣。

translations.literal: In Hongzhi 16 he died; his younger brother Duanshu Jianzan was ordered to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Hongzhi 16; his younger brother Duanshu Jianzan was ordered to succeed.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖後猶入貢如制。

translations.literal: After Jiajing they still came with tribute according to regulation.
translations.idiomatic: After Jiajing they still sent tribute according to regulation.

sentences.zh: 護教王

translations.literal: The Protection-Teaching King
translations.idiomatic: The Protection-Teaching King

sentences.zh: 護教王者，名宗巴斡即南哥巴藏卜，館覺僧也。

translations.literal: The Protection-Teaching King, named Zongbawo, that is Nange Bazangbu, was a Guanjue monk.
translations.idiomatic: The Protection-Teaching King, named Zongbawo — that is, Nange Bazangbu — was a Guanjue monk.

sentences.zh: 成祖初，僧智光使其地。

translations.literal: Early in Chengzu the monk Zhiguang was sent to his territory.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Chengzu's reign the monk Zhiguang was sent to his territory.

sentences.zh: 永樂四年遣使入貢，詔授灌頂國師，賜之誥。

translations.literal: In Yongle 4 he sent envoys with tribute; an edict appointed him Abhisheka State Teacher and granted him a patent.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 4 he sent tribute; an edict made him Abhisheka State Teacher and granted a patent.

sentences.zh: 明年遣使入謝，封為護教王，賜金印、誥命，國師如故。

translations.literal: The next year he sent envoys to give thanks; he was enfeoffed Protection-Teaching King, granted gold seal and patent commission, State Teacher title unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he sent envoys to give thanks and was enfeoffed Protection-Teaching King with a gold seal and patent, his State Teacher title unchanged.

sentences.zh: 遂頻歲入貢。

translations.literal: Thereafter he came with tribute every year.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter he sent tribute nearly every year.

sentences.zh: 十二年卒，命其從子幹些兒吉剌思巴藏卜嗣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he died; his nephew Ganxie'er Jelisi Bazangbu was ordered to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twelfth year; his nephew Ganxie'er Jelisi Bazangbu was ordered to succeed.

sentences.zh: 洪熙、宣德中併入貢。

translations.literal: In Hongxi and Xuande he came together with others in tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongxi and Xuande he sent tribute together with others.

sentences.zh: 已而卒，無嗣，其爵遂絕。

translations.literal: Later he died without heirs, and the title thus lapsed.
translations.idiomatic: He later died without heirs, and the title lapsed.

sentences.zh: 闡教王

translations.literal: The Propagation-Teaching King
translations.idiomatic: The Propagation-Teaching King

sentences.zh: 闡教王者，必力工瓦僧也。

translations.literal: The Propagation-Teaching King was a Bili Gongwa monk.
translations.idiomatic: The Propagation-Teaching King was a Bili Gongwa monk.

sentences.zh: 成祖初，僧智光齎敕入番，其國師端竹監藏遣使入貢。

translations.literal: Early in Chengzu the monk Zhiguang carried an edict into the tribes; its State Teacher Duanshu Jiancang sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Chengzu's reign the monk Zhiguang carried an edict into the tribes; its State Teacher Duanshu Jiancang sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 永樂元年至京，帝喜，宴賚遣還。

translations.literal: In Yongle 1 they reached the capital; the emperor was pleased, feasted and rewarded them, and sent them back.
translations.idiomatic: They reached the capital in Yongle 1; the emperor was pleased, feasted and rewarded them, and sent them home.

sentences.zh: 四年又貢，帝優賜，並賜其國師大板的達、律師鎖南藏卜衣幣。

translations.literal: In the fourth year they again sent tribute; the emperor gave generous rewards and also bestowed robes and silks on State Teachers Dabandada and Law Master Suonan Zangbu.
translations.idiomatic: They sent tribute again in the fourth year; the emperor gave generous rewards and also bestowed robes and silks on State Teachers Dabandada and Law Master Suonan Zangbu.

sentences.zh: 十一年乃加號灌頂慈慧淨戒大國師，又封其僧領真巴兒吉監藏為闡教王，賜印誥、彩幣。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was additionally titled Abhisheka Great State Teacher of Compassionate Wisdom and Pure Precepts, and the monk Lingzhen Ba'erji Jiancang was enfeoffed Propagation-Teaching King, granted seal, patent, and colored silks.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he received the additional title Abhisheka Great State Teacher of Compassionate Wisdom and Pure Precepts, and the monk Lingzhen Ba'erji Jiancang was enfeoffed Propagation-Teaching King with seal, patent, and colored silks.

sentences.zh: 後比年一貢。

translations.literal: Thereafter tribute came nearly every year.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter tribute came nearly every year.

sentences.zh: 楊三保、戴興、侯顯之使，皆齎金幣、佛像、法器賜焉。

translations.literal: The missions of Yang Sanbao, Dai Xing, and Hou Xian all carried gold coins, Buddha images, and ritual implements as gifts to them.
translations.idiomatic: The missions of Yang Sanbao, Dai Xing, and Hou Xian all brought gold coins, Buddha images, and ritual implements as gifts.

sentences.zh: 宣德五年，王卒，命其子綽兒加監巴領占嗣。

translations.literal: In Xuande 5 the king died; his son Chuo'erjia Jianba Lingzhan was ordered to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande 5 the king died; his son Chuo'erjia Jianba Lingzhan was ordered to succeed.

sentences.zh: 久之卒，命其子領占叭兒結堅參嗣。

translations.literal: After a long time he died; his son Lingzhan Ba'er Jiejian Can was ordered to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: He died after a long reign; his son Lingzhan Ba'er Jiejian Can was ordered to succeed.

sentences.zh: 成化四年從禮官言，申三歲一貢之制。

translations.literal: In Chenghua 4, following ritual officials' proposal, the triennial tribute system was reaffirmed.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua 4, on ritual officials' advice, the triennial tribute rule was reaffirmed.

sentences.zh: 明年，王卒，命其子領占堅參叭兒藏卜襲。

translations.literal: The next year the king died; his son Lingzhan Jiancan Ba'er Zangbu was ordered to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the king died; his son Lingzhan Jiancan Ba'er Zangbu succeeded.

sentences.zh: 二十年，帝遣番僧班著兒齎璽書勘合往賜。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year the emperor sent the Tibetan monk Banzhe'er carrying an imperial letter and tally to go bestow gifts.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year the emperor sent the Tibetan monk Banzhe'er with an imperial letter and tally to bestow gifts.

sentences.zh: 其僧憚行，至半道，偽為王印信、番文覆命，詔逮治。

translations.literal: That monk feared the journey; midway he forged the king's seal and a tribal document and returned with a false report; an edict ordered his arrest and punishment.
translations.idiomatic: That monk feared the journey; halfway there he forged the king's seal and a tribal document and returned with a false report; an edict ordered his arrest.

sentences.zh: 正德十三年遣番僧領占答刂巴等封其新王。

translations.literal: In Zhengde 13 Tibetan monks including Lingzhan Daliba were sent to enfeoff the new king.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengde 13 Tibetan monks including Lingzhan Daliba were sent to enfeoff the new king.

sentences.zh: 答刂巴等乞馬快船三十艘載食鹽，為入番買路之資。

translations.literal: Daliba and the others asked for thirty fast courier boats carrying salt as funds to buy passage into the tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Daliba and the others asked for thirty fast courier boats loaded with salt to buy their way into the tribes.

sentences.zh: 戶科、戶部並疏爭，不聽。

translations.literal: The Households Section of the Censorate and the Ministry of Revenue both memorialized in opposition; he would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: The Households Section and the Ministry of Revenue both memorialized in opposition, but the emperor would not heed them.

sentences.zh: 答刂巴等在途科索無厭，至呂梁，毆管洪主事李瑜幾斃，恣橫如此。

translations.literal: Daliba and the others extorted without limit on the road; at Lüliang they beat Director Li Yu of the grain transport bureau nearly to death — such was their arrogance.
translations.idiomatic: Daliba and the others extorted without end on the road; at Lüliang they beat Director Li Yu of the grain transport bureau nearly to death — such was their arrogance.

sentences.zh: 迄嘉靖世，闡教王修貢不輟。

translations.literal: Through the Jiajing reign the Propagation-Teaching King maintained tribute without cease.
translations.idiomatic: Through the Jiajing reign the Propagation-Teaching King maintained tribute without cease.

sentences.zh: 輔教王

translations.literal: The Assistant-Teaching King
translations.idiomatic: The Assistant-Teaching King

sentences.zh: 成化五年，王卒，命其子喃葛答刂失堅參叭藏卜嗣。

translations.literal: In Chenghua 5 the king died; his son Nange Dalisi Jiancan Ba Zangbu was ordered to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua 5 the king died; his son Nange Dalisi Jiancan Ba Zangbu was ordered to succeed.

sentences.zh: 六年申舊制，三年一貢，多不過百五十人，由四川雅州入。

translations.literal: In the sixth year the old rule was reaffirmed: tribute once every three years, generally no more than one hundred fifty persons, entering through Yazhou in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the old rule was reaffirmed: triennial tribute, generally no more than 150 persons, entering through Yazhou in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 國師以下不許貢。

translations.literal: State Teachers and those below were not permitted to send tribute.
translations.idiomatic: State Teachers and those below were not permitted to send tribute.

sentences.zh: 弘治十二年，輔教等四王及長河西宣慰司並時入貢，使者至二千八百余人。

translations.literal: In Hongzhi 12 the four kings including Assistant-Teaching and the Chang River West Pacification Commission all came with tribute at once; envoys numbered more than two thousand eight hundred.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongzhi 12 the four kings including Assistant-Teaching and the Chang River West Pacification Commission all came at once; envoys numbered more than 2,800.

sentences.zh: 禮官以供費不貲，請敕四川守臣遵制遣送，違者卻還，從之。

translations.literal: Ritual officials, because supply costs were beyond reckoning, asked that Sichuan frontier officials be ordered to escort them according to regulation and send back violators; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officials, finding supply costs beyond reckoning, asked that Sichuan frontier officials escort parties under the rules and send back violators; this was approved.

sentences.zh: 歷正德、嘉靖世，奉貢不絕。

translations.literal: Through the Zhengde and Jiajing reigns tribute continued without end.
translations.idiomatic: Through the Zhengde and Jiajing reigns tribute continued without end.

sentences.zh: 西天阿難功德國

translations.literal: The Western Heaven Kingdom of Ananda's Meritorious Virtue
translations.idiomatic: The Western Heaven Kingdom of Ananda's Meritorious Virtue

sentences.zh: 西天阿難功德國，西方番國也。

translations.literal: The Western Heaven Kingdom of Ananda's Meritorious Virtue was a western tribal state.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Heaven Kingdom of Ananda's Meritorious Virtue was a western tribal state.

sentences.zh: 洪武七年，王卜哈魯遣其講主必尼西來朝，貢方物及解毒藥石。

translations.literal: In Hongwu 7 King Puhalu sent his lecturer Beni to court, offering local products and antidote mineral drugs.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 7 King Puhalu sent his lecturer Beni to court with local products and antidote mineral drugs.

sentences.zh: 詔賜文綺、禪衣及布帛諸物。

translations.literal: An edict bestowed patterned silks, Chan robes, and various cloth goods.
translations.idiomatic: An edict bestowed patterned silks, Chan robes, and cloth goods.

sentences.zh: 後不復至。

translations.literal: They did not come again thereafter.
translations.idiomatic: They did not come again.

sentences.zh: 又有和林國師朵兒只怯烈失思巴藏卜，亦遣其講主汝奴汪叔來朝，獻銅佛、舍利、白哈丹布及元所授玉印一、玉圖書一、銀印四、銅印五、金字牌三，命宴賚遣還。

translations.literal: Also the Karakorum State Teacher Dorji Qieliesi Siba Zangbu sent his lecturer Runu Wangshu to court, presenting a bronze Buddha, śarīra, white hadan cloth, and one jade seal, one jade document seal, four silver seals, five bronze seals, and three gold-lettered tablets granted by the Yuan; he was ordered feasted, rewarded, and sent back.
translations.idiomatic: Also the Karakorum State Teacher Dorji Qieliesi Siba Zangbu sent his lecturer Runu Wangshu to court with a bronze Buddha, śarīra, white hadan cloth, and the Yuan-granted seals and gold-lettered tablets; he was feasted, rewarded, and sent home.

sentences.zh: 明年，國師入朝，又獻佛像、舍利、馬二匹，賜文綺、禪衣。

translations.literal: The next year the State Teacher came to court and again presented Buddha images, śarīra, and two horses; he was granted patterned silks and Chan robes.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the State Teacher came to court with Buddha images, śarīra, and two horses, and received patterned silks and Chan robes.

sentences.zh: 和林，即元太祖故都，在極北，非西番，其國師則番僧。

translations.literal: Karakorum was the former capital of Yuan Taizu, in the far north — not western Tibet — though its State Teacher was a Tibetan monk.
translations.idiomatic: Karakorum was the Yuan founder's former capital, in the far north — not western Tibet — though its State Teacher was a Tibetan monk.

sentences.zh: 與功德國同時來貢，後亦不復至。

translations.literal: They came with tribute at the same time as the Meritorious Virtue Kingdom and likewise did not come again thereafter.
translations.idiomatic: They came with tribute at the same time as the Meritorious Virtue Kingdom and likewise did not come again.

sentences.zh: 西天尼八剌國

translations.literal: The Western Heaven Kingdom of Nepal
translations.idiomatic: The Western Heaven Kingdom of Nepal

sentences.zh: 尼八剌國，在諸藏之西，去中國絕遠。

translations.literal: The Kingdom of Nepal lay west of the various Tibetan regions, extremely far from China.
translations.idiomatic: Nepal lay west of the Tibetan regions, extremely far from China.

sentences.zh: 其王皆僧為之。

translations.literal: Its kings were all monks.
translations.idiomatic: All its kings were monks.

sentences.zh: 洪武十七年，太祖命僧智光齎璽書、彩幣往，並使其鄰境地涌塔國。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Hongwu the Founder ordered the monk Zhiguang to carry an imperial letter and patterned silks thither, and also to visit the neighboring country of Diyongta.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 17 the Founder sent the monk Zhiguang with an imperial letter and silks, and also to the neighboring kingdom of Diyongta.

sentences.zh: 智光精釋典，負才辨，宣揚天子德意。

translations.literal: Zhiguang was well versed in Buddhist scripture, possessed eloquence and learning, and proclaimed the Son of Heaven's virtuous intentions.
translations.idiomatic: Zhiguang knew the scriptures well, spoke with force and learning, and carried the emperor's benevolent message.

sentences.zh: 其王馬達納羅摩遣使隨入朝，貢金塔、佛經及名馬方物。

translations.literal: Its king Madanaralamo sent envoys to accompany him to court, offering golden pagodas, Buddhist scriptures, fine horses, and local products.
translations.idiomatic: King Madanaralamo sent envoys with him to court, presenting golden pagodas, scriptures, fine horses, and regional goods.

sentences.zh: 二十年達京師。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year they reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: They reached the capital in the twentieth year.

sentences.zh: 帝喜，賜銀印、玉圖書、誥敕、符驗及幡幢、彩幣。

translations.literal: The emperor was pleased and granted a silver seal, jade patent, edict patent, tally tokens, banners, and patterned silks.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was pleased and granted a silver seal, jade patent, edict, tally tokens, banners, and silks.

sentences.zh: 二十三年再貢，加賜玉圖書、紅羅傘。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year they sent tribute again; he additionally granted a jade patent and a red silk parasol.
translations.idiomatic: They sent tribute again in the twenty-third year and received an additional jade patent and red silk parasol.

sentences.zh: 終太祖時，數歲一貢。

translations.literal: Throughout the Founder's reign they sent tribute every few years.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Founder they sent tribute every few years.

sentences.zh: 成祖覆命智光使其國。

translations.literal: Chengzu again ordered Zhiguang to go as envoy to their country.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzu again sent Zhiguang as envoy to Nepal.

sentences.zh: 永樂七年遣使來貢。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yongle they sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 7 they sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一年命楊三保齎璽書、銀幣賜其嗣王沙的新葛及地涌塔王可般。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Yang Sanbao was ordered to carry an imperial letter and silver gifts to bestow on the successor king Sha Di Xinge and the king of Diyongta, Keban.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year the eunuch Yang Sanbao was sent with an imperial letter and silver for the successor king Sha Di Xinge and Diyongta king Keban.

sentences.zh: 明年遣使來貢。

translations.literal: The next year they sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: They sent tribute the next year.

sentences.zh: 封沙的新葛為尼八剌國王，賜誥及鍍金銀印。

translations.literal: Sha Di Xinge was enfeoffed King of Nepal and granted a patent and a gilded silver seal.
translations.idiomatic: Sha Di Xinge was enfeoffed King of Nepal and given a patent and gilded silver seal.

sentences.zh: 十六年遣使來貢，命中官鄧誠齎璽書、錦綺、紗羅往報之。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year they sent envoys with tribute; the eunuch Deng Cheng was ordered to carry an imperial letter, brocades, and gauze silks in reply.
translations.idiomatic: They sent tribute in the sixteenth year, and the eunuch Deng Cheng was dispatched with an imperial letter, brocades, and gauze silks in return.

sentences.zh: 所經罕東、靈藏、必力工瓦、烏斯藏及野藍卜納，皆有賜。

translations.literal: Along the route through Handong, Lingzang, Biligongwa, U-Tsang, and Yelanbuna, gifts were bestowed at each place.
translations.idiomatic: Gifts were granted at Handong, Lingzang, Biligongwa, U-Tsang, and Yelanbuna along the route.

sentences.zh: 宣德二年又遣中官侯顯賜其王絨錦、糹寧絲，地涌塔王如之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuande the eunuch Hou Xian was again sent to bestow velvet brocade and crimson silk on its king; the king of Diyongta received the same.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande 2 the eunuch Hou Xian again bestowed velvet brocade and crimson silk on the king; the Diyongta king received the same.

sentences.zh: 自後，貢使不復至。

translations.literal: After this tribute envoys came no more.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute envoys did not come again thereafter.

sentences.zh: 又有速睹嵩者，亦西方之國。

translations.literal: There was also Sudusong, likewise a country of the west.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Sudusong, another western kingdom.

sentences.zh: 永樂三年遣行人連迪等齎敕往招，賜銀鈔、彩幣。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongle palace messengers including Liandi were sent carrying an edict to summon them, and silver notes and patterned silks were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 3 palace messengers led by Liandi were sent with an edict of summons and silver notes and silks.

sentences.zh: 其酋以道遠不至。

translations.literal: Its chieftain, citing the long distance, did not come.
translations.idiomatic: Its chieftain, citing the distance, did not come.

sentences.zh: 朵甘烏斯藏行都指揮使司

translations.literal: The Route Regional Military Commission of Duo-Gan and U-Tsang
translations.idiomatic: The Route Regional Military Commission of Duo-Gan and U-Tsang

sentences.zh: 朵甘，在四川徼外，南與烏斯藏鄰，唐吐蕃地。

translations.literal: Duo-Gan lay beyond the frontier of Sichuan, bordering U-Tsang to the south; in Tang times it was Tibetan land.
translations.idiomatic: Duo-Gan lay beyond Sichuan's marches, bordering U-Tsang to the south; in Tang times it was Tibetan territory.

sentences.zh: 元置宣慰司、招討司、元帥府、萬戶府，分統其眾。

translations.literal: Under the Yuan there were established pacification commissions, bandit-suppression commissions, marshalates, and battalion commands to rule its peoples separately.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan established pacification commissions, bandit-suppression commissions, marshalates, and battalion commands to govern the region in parts.

sentences.zh: 洪武二年，太祖定陝西，即遣官齎詔招撫。

translations.literal: In the second year of Hongwu, once the Founder had secured Shaanxi, he immediately sent officials bearing edicts to summon and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 2, after securing Shaanxi, the Founder immediately sent officials with edicts to summon and pacify the region.

sentences.zh: 又遣員外郎許允德諭其酋長，舉元故官赴京。

translations.literal: He also sent Outside Secretary Xu Yunde to instruct their chieftains to recommend former Yuan officials to come to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He also sent Outside Secretary Xu Yunde to instruct the chieftains to recommend former Yuan officials for court appointment.

sentences.zh: 攝帝師喃加巴藏卜及故國公南哥思丹八亦監藏等於六年春入朝，上所舉六十人名。

translations.literal: The Regent Imperial Preceptor Namgyel Pakzangpo and the former State Duke Nangyesidanba Yijiancang and others came to court in the spring of the sixth year, presenting the names of the sixty men recommended above.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the sixth year the Regent Imperial Preceptor Namgyel Pakzangpo and the former State Duke Nangyesidanba Yijiancang came to court with the sixty recommended names.

sentences.zh: 帝喜，置指揮使司二，曰朵甘，曰烏斯藏，宣慰司二，元帥府一，招討司四，萬戶府十三，千戶所四，即以所舉官任之。

translations.literal: The emperor was pleased and established two guard commissions, called Duo-Gan and U-Tsang; two pacification commissions; one marshalate; four bandit-suppression commissions; thirteen battalion commands; and four company commands, appointing the recommended officials to these posts.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was pleased and established guard commissions at Duo-Gan and U-Tsang, two pacification commissions, one marshalate, four bandit-suppression commissions, thirteen battalion commands, and four company commands, appointing the recommended men to office.

sentences.zh: 廷臣言來朝者授職，不來者宜弗予。

translations.literal: Court officials said that those who came to court should receive posts, and those who did not come ought not to be granted them.
translations.idiomatic: Court officials argued that only those who came to court should receive posts.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「吾以誠心待人。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "I treat people with sincere heart.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "I treat people with sincere good faith.

sentences.zh: 彼不誠，曲在彼矣。

translations.literal: If they are not sincere, the fault lies with them.
translations.idiomatic: If they are insincere, the fault is theirs alone.

sentences.zh: 萬里來朝，俟其再請，豈不負遠人歸向之心。」

translations.literal: They have come ten thousand li to court; to wait until they ask again—would that not betray the hearts of distant peoples turning toward us?
translations.idiomatic: They have come ten thousand li to court; to make them ask again would betray the hearts of distant peoples who turn to us.

sentences.zh: 遂皆授之。

translations.literal: Thereupon all were granted office.
translations.idiomatic: All were then granted office.

sentences.zh: 降詔曰：「我國家受天明命，統御萬方，恩撫善良，武威不服。

translations.literal: An edict was issued, saying: "Our state has received Heaven's bright mandate and rules the myriad regions, showing kindness to the good and displaying martial might toward the disobedient.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ran: "Our state has received Heaven's mandate and rules all lands, showing kindness to the good and martial might to the disobedient.

sentences.zh: 凡在幅員之內，咸推一視之仁。

translations.literal: All within our territorial reach are treated with the same impartial benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: All within our domain receive the same impartial care.

sentences.zh: 乃者攝帝師喃加巴藏卜率所舉故國公、司徒、宣慰、招討、元帥、萬戶諸人，自遠入朝。

translations.literal: Recently the Regent Imperial Preceptor Namgyel Pakzangpo has led the former state dukes, ministers of merit, pacification commissioners, bandit-suppression commissioners, marshals, and battalion commanders he recommended, coming to court from afar.
translations.idiomatic: Recently the Regent Imperial Preceptor Namgyel Pakzangpo led the former state dukes, ministers, pacification commissioners, bandit-suppression commissioners, marshals, and battalion commanders he recommended to court from afar.

sentences.zh: 朕嘉其識天命，不勞師旅，共效職方之貢。

translations.literal: We commend their recognition of Heaven's mandate, that without requiring armies they together fulfill the tribute obligations of their offices.
translations.idiomatic: We commend their recognition of Heaven's mandate: without armies they fulfill their tribute duties.

sentences.zh: 已授國師及故國公等為指揮同知等官，皆給誥印。

translations.literal: State Teachers and former state dukes and the like have already been appointed to posts such as assistant regional commander, and patents and seals have all been granted.
translations.idiomatic: State Teachers and former state dukes have been appointed assistant regional commanders and the like, each receiving patent and seal.

sentences.zh: 自今為官者務遵朝廷法，撫安一方。

translations.literal: From now on those who hold office must follow the court's laws and pacify their regions.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth officeholders must obey the court's laws and keep their regions at peace.

sentences.zh: 僧務敦化導之誠，率民為善，共享太平，永綏福祉，豈不休哉。」

translations.literal: Monks must earnestly guide through teaching and transformation, leading the people toward goodness so all may share peace and enjoy lasting blessing—how splendid!
translations.idiomatic: Monks must earnestly teach and lead the people toward goodness so all may share peace and lasting blessing—what joy!

sentences.zh: 並宴賚遣還。

translations.literal: They were feasted, rewarded, and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: They were feasted, rewarded, and sent home.

sentences.zh: 初，元尊番僧為帝師，授其徒國公等秩，故降者襲舊號。

translations.literal: At first, because the Yuan honored Tibetan monks as Imperial Preceptors and granted their disciples ranks such as state duke, those who submitted inherited their old titles.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan Tibetan monks had been honored as Imperial Preceptors and their disciples made state dukes; submitters therefore kept their old titles.

sentences.zh: 鎖南兀即爾者歸朝，授朵甘衛指揮僉事。

translations.literal: Suonan Wujier submitted to court and was appointed assistant regional commander of the Duo-Gan Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Suonan Wujier submitted to court and was made assistant regional commander of the Duo-Gan Guard.

sentences.zh: 以元司徒銀印來上，命進指揮同知。

translations.literal: Because he presented the Yuan Minister of Merit silver seal, he was ordered promoted to assistant regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: He presented the Yuan Minister of Merit silver seal and was promoted to assistant regional commander.

sentences.zh: 已而朵甘宣慰賞竹監藏舉首領可為指揮、宣慰、萬戶、千戶者二十二人。

translations.literal: Soon afterward the Duo-Gan Pacification Commissioner Shangzhu Jiancang recommended twenty-two chieftains fit to serve as regional commanders, pacification commissioners, battalion commanders, and company commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Duo-Gan Pacification Commissioner Shangzhu Jiancang recommended twenty-two chieftains for command, pacification, battalion, and company posts.

sentences.zh: 詔從其請，鑄分司印予之。

translations.literal: An edict approved his request and branch-office seals were cast and given to them.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved and branch-office seals were cast for them.

sentences.zh: 乃改朵甘、烏斯藏二衛為行都指揮使司，以鎖南兀即爾為朵甘都指揮同知，管招兀即爾為烏斯藏都指揮同知，並賜銀印。

translations.literal: Thereupon the two guards of Duo-Gan and U-Tsang were changed to route regional military commissions; Suonan Wujier was made assistant regional commander of Duo-Gan, Guanzhao Wujier assistant regional commander of U-Tsang, and silver seals were granted to both.
translations.idiomatic: The Duo-Gan and U-Tsang guards were then made route regional military commissions; Suonan Wujier became assistant regional commander of Duo-Gan and Guanzhao Wujier of U-Tsang, each receiving a silver seal.

sentences.zh: 又設西安行都指揮使司於河州，兼轄二都司。

translations.literal: A route regional military commission of Xi'an was also established at Hezhou to govern both route commissions.
translations.idiomatic: A Xi'an route regional military commission was also established at Hezhou to govern both commissions.

sentences.zh: 已，佛寶國師鎖南兀即爾等遣使來朝，奏舉故官賞竹監藏等五十六人。

translations.literal: Later the Blazing Buddha-Treasure State Preceptor Suonan Wujier and others sent envoys to court, memorializing to recommend fifty-six former officials including Shangzhu Jiancang.
translations.idiomatic: Later the Blazing Buddha-Treasure State Preceptor Suonan Wujier sent envoys recommending fifty-six former officials including Shangzhu Jiancang.

sentences.zh: 命增置朵甘思宣慰司及招討等司。

translations.literal: An order was issued to add the Duo-Gan Pacification Commission and bandit-suppression commissions and the like.
translations.idiomatic: The Duo-Gan Pacification Commission and bandit-suppression commissions were added.

sentences.zh: 招討司六：曰朵甘思，曰朵甘隴答，曰朵甘丹，曰朵甘倉溏，曰朵甘川，曰磨兒勘。

translations.literal: Six bandit-suppression commissions: Duo-Gan Si, Duo-Gan Longda, Duo-Gan Dan, Duo-Gan Cangtang, Duo-Gan Chuan, and Mo'erkan.
translations.idiomatic: Six bandit-suppression commissions: Duo-Gan Si, Duo-Gan Longda, Duo-Gan Dan, Duo-Gan Cangtang, Duo-Gan Chuan, and Mo'erkan.

sentences.zh: 萬戶府四：曰沙兒可，曰乃竹，曰羅思端，曰列思麻。

translations.literal: Four battalion commands: Sha'erke, Naizhu, Luosiduan, and Liesima.
translations.idiomatic: Four battalion commands: Sha'erke, Naizhu, Luosiduan, and Liesima.

sentences.zh: 千戶所十七。

translations.literal: Seventeen company commands.
translations.idiomatic: Seventeen company commands.

sentences.zh: 以賞竹監藏為朵甘都指揮同知，余授職有差。

translations.literal: Shangzhu Jiancang was made assistant regional commander of Duo-Gan; the rest received posts according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: Shangzhu Jiancang became assistant regional commander of Duo-Gan; the rest received posts of varying rank.

sentences.zh: 自是，諸番修貢惟謹。

translations.literal: From then on the various tribes observed tribute with scrupulous care.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the tribes observed tribute with scrupulous care.

sentences.zh: 八年置俄力思軍民元帥府。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the military-civilian marshalate of Eulisi was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the Eulisi military-civilian marshalate was established.

sentences.zh: 尋置隴答衛指揮使司。

translations.literal: Soon the Longda Guard regional military commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Longda Guard commission was soon established.

sentences.zh: 十八年以班竹兒藏卜為烏斯藏都指揮使。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Banzha'er Zangbu was made regional commander of U-Tsang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year Banzha'er Zangbu became regional commander of U-Tsang.

sentences.zh: 乃更定品秩，自都指揮以下皆令世襲。

translations.literal: Ranks were then redefined, and from regional commander downward all posts were made hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks were redefined and all posts from regional commander down were made hereditary.

sentences.zh: 未幾，又改烏斯藏俺不羅衛為行都指揮使司。

translations.literal: Before long the U-Tsang Enboluo Guard was also changed to a route regional military commission.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the U-Tsang Enboluo Guard was also made a route regional military commission.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，西番思曩日等族遣使貢馬，命賜金銅信符、文綺、襲衣，許之朝貢。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year the western tribes Sinangri and others sent envoys offering horses; they were ordered granted gold-and-copper tally tokens, patterned silks, and ceremonial robes, and permission to come to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year the western tribes Sinangri and others sent horses; they received gold-and-copper tally tokens, brocades, and ceremonial robes and were permitted to send tribute.

sentences.zh: 正統初，以供費不貲，稍為裁損。

translations.literal: Early in Zhengtong, because the cost of supplies could not be borne, reductions were made.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Zhengtong the cost of hospitality could not be sustained and allowances were cut back.

sentences.zh: 時有番長移書松潘守將趙得，言欲入朝，為生番阻遏，乞遣兵開道。

translations.literal: At that time a tribal chieftain wrote to Zhao De, garrison commander of Songpan, saying he wished to come to court but was blocked by raw tribes, and begging that troops be sent to open the way.
translations.idiomatic: A tribal chieftain wrote to Songpan garrison commander Zhao De saying he wished to come to court but was blocked by hostile tribes and asked for troops to open the road.

sentences.zh: 詔令得遣使招生番，相率朝貢者八百二十九寨，翻賜賚遣歸。

translations.literal: An edict ordered De to send envoys to summon raw tribes; eight hundred twenty-nine settlements came in groups to court with tribute, were feasted and rewarded, and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: De was ordered to summon the raw tribes; 829 settlements came to court with tribute, were feasted and rewarded, and sent home.

sentences.zh: 天順四年，四川三司言：「比奉敕書，番僧朝貢入京者不得過十人，余留境上候賞。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tianshun the three offices of Sichuan said: "We have recently received an edict that no more than ten Tibetan monk tribute-bearers may enter the capital; the rest are to remain at the frontier awaiting rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianshun 4 the three Sichuan offices said, "An edict recently limits tribute monks entering the capital to ten; the rest must wait at the frontier for rewards.

sentences.zh: 今蜀地災傷，若悉留之，動經數月，有司困於供億。

translations.literal: Now Sichuan has suffered disaster and famine; if all are kept, they often remain for months, and local offices are exhausted supplying them.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan has suffered disaster; if all are kept, they often stay for months and local offices are exhausted supplying them.

sentences.zh: 宜如正統間制，宴待遣還。」

translations.literal: It would be best to follow the Zhengtong practice: feasting them and sending them back.
translations.idiomatic: We ask to follow the Zhengtong practice of feasting them and sending them back.

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 成化三年，阿昔洞諸族土官言：「西番大小二姓為惡，殺之不懼。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chenghua the native officials of the Axidong tribes said: "The two great and lesser clans of the western tribes do evil and fear no punishment even for murder.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua 3 the Axidong native officials said, "The great and lesser clans of the western tribes do evil and fear no punishment, not even for murder.

sentences.zh: 惟國師、剌麻勸化，則革心信服。」

translations.literal: Only when State Teachers and lamas exhort and transform them do they change their hearts and submit in faith.
translations.idiomatic: Only State Teachers and lamas can reform them and win their hearts.

sentences.zh: 乃進禪師遠丹藏卜為國師，都綱子瑺為禪師，以化導之。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Chan master Yuandan Zangbu was advanced to State Teacher and the abbacy director Zichang to Chan master, to guide and transform them.
translations.idiomatic: The Chan master Yuandan Zangbu was made State Teacher and abbacy director Zichang Chan master to guide them.

sentences.zh: 六年，申諸番三歲一貢之例，國師以下不許貢，於是貢使漸希。

translations.literal: In the sixth year the triennial tribute rule for the various tribes was reaffirmed; those below State Teacher were not permitted to send tribute, and thereafter tribute envoys grew scarce.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the triennial tribute rule was reaffirmed and tribute below State Teacher was forbidden; envoys thereafter grew scarce.

sentences.zh: 初，太祖以西番地廣，人獷悍，欲分其勢而殺其力，使不為邊患，故來者輒授官。

translations.literal: At first the Founder, because the western tribes' lands were vast and their people fierce and hardy, wished to divide their strength and drain their power so they would not become a border trouble; therefore whoever came was promptly granted office.
translations.idiomatic: The Founder, knowing the western tribes occupied vast lands and bred fierce men, sought to divide and weaken them so they would not trouble the frontier; whoever came was promptly given office.

sentences.zh: 又以其地皆食肉，倚中國茶為命，故設茶課司於天全六番，令以馬市，而入貢者又優以茶布。

translations.literal: Moreover, because they all ate meat and depended on Chinese tea for their livelihood, a tea tax office was established among the Six Tribes of Tianquan to trade for horses, and tribute-bearers were additionally favored with tea and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Because they ate meat and depended on Chinese tea, a tea tax office was set up among the Six Tribes of Tianquan for horse trade, and tribute-bearers were favored with tea and cloth.

sentences.zh: 諸番戀貢市之利，且欲保世官，不敢為變。

translations.literal: The tribes clung to the profits of tribute and trade and also wished to preserve hereditary office, and dared not rebel.
translations.idiomatic: The tribes clung to tribute and trade profits and wished to keep hereditary office, and dared not rebel.

sentences.zh: 迨成祖，益封法王及大國師、西天佛子等，俾轉相化導，以共尊中國，以故西陲宴然，終明世無番寇之患。

translations.literal: By Chengzu's time more Dharma Kings, Great State Teachers, and Buddha Sons of the Western Heaven were enfeoffed, that they might teach and transform one another and together honor China; therefore the western frontier remained tranquil, and throughout the Ming there was no trouble from tribal raids.
translations.idiomatic: Under Chengzu more Dharma Kings, Great State Teachers, and Buddha Sons of the Western Heaven were enfeoffed to teach one another and honor China together; the western frontier therefore stayed quiet, and the Ming saw no tribal raids.

sentences.zh: 長河西魚通寧遠宣慰司

translations.literal: The Chang River West Fish Pass Ningyuan Pacification Commission
translations.idiomatic: The Chang River West Fish Pass Ningyuan Pacification Commission

sentences.zh: 長河西魚通寧遠宣慰司，在四川徼外，地通烏斯藏，唐為吐蕃。

translations.literal: The Chang River West Fish Pass Ningyuan Pacification Commission lay beyond the frontier of Sichuan; its lands connected with U-Tsang; in Tang times it was Tibetan territory.
translations.idiomatic: The Chang River West Fish Pass Ningyuan Pacification Commission lay beyond Sichuan's marches, connected with U-Tsang, and was Tibetan territory in Tang times.

sentences.zh: 元時置碉門、魚通、黎、雅、長河西、寧遠六安撫司，隸吐蕃宣慰司。

translations.literal: Under the Yuan six pacification offices were established at Diaomen, Yutong, Li, Ya, Chang River West, and Ningyuan, subordinate to the Tibetan Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan established six pacification offices at Diaomen, Yutong, Li, Ya, Chang River West, and Ningyuan under the Tibetan Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 洪武時，其地打煎爐、長河西土官元右丞剌瓦蒙遣其理問高惟善來朝，貢方物，宴賚遣還。

translations.literal: During Hongwu the native official of Dajianlu and Chang River West, the Yuan Right Assistant Minister Lawamo, sent his administrative clerk Gao Weishan to court with local products; he was feasted, rewarded, and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: During Hongwu the Dajianlu and Chang River West native official, the former Yuan Right Assistant Minister Lawamo, sent his clerk Gao Weishan to court with local products; he was feasted, rewarded, and sent home.

sentences.zh: 十六年復遣惟善及從子萬戶若剌來貢。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year Weishan and his nephew, battalion commander Ruola, were again sent with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year Weishan and his nephew, battalion commander Ruola, came again with tribute.

sentences.zh: 命置長河西等處軍民安撫司，以剌瓦蒙為安撫使，賜文綺四十八匹，鈔二百錠，授惟善禮部主事。

translations.literal: An order was issued to establish the military-civilian pacification office of Chang River West and other places; Lawamo was made pacification commissioner, granted forty-eight bolts of patterned silk and two hundred ingots of paper money, and Weishan was appointed a principal secretary in the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: The Chang River West military-civilian pacification office was established; Lawamo became pacification commissioner with forty-eight bolts of brocade and two hundred ingots of paper money, and Weishan was made a principal secretary in the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 二十年遣惟善招撫長河西、魚通、寧遠諸處，明年還朝，言：安邊之道，在治屯守，而兼恩威。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Weishan was sent to summon and pacify Chang River West, Yutong, Ningyuan, and other places; the next year he returned to court and said: "The way to secure the border lies in governing garrison colonies, combining kindness and might."
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year Weishan was sent to pacify Chang River West, Yutong, and Ningyuan; returning the next year he said, "Securing the border requires strong garrisons and a balance of kindness and might."

sentences.zh: 屯守既堅，雖遠而有功；

translations.literal: When garrison colonies are firm, even distant places can be made effective;
translations.idiomatic: Strong garrisons make even distant places effective;

sentences.zh: 恩威未備，雖近而無益。

translations.literal: when kindness and might are incomplete, even nearby places gain nothing.
translations.idiomatic: without both kindness and might, even nearby places profit nothing.

sentences.zh: 今魚通、九枝疆土及岩州、雜道二長官司，東鄰碉門、黎、雅，西接長河西。

translations.literal: Now the territories of Yutong and Jiuzhi and the two native-official offices of Yanzhou and Zadao border Diaomen, Li, and Ya to the east and Chang River West to the west.
translations.idiomatic: Yutong, Jiuzhi, and the Yanzhou and Zadao native offices border Diaomen, Li, and Ya to the east and Chang River West to the west.

sentences.zh: 自唐時吐蕃強盛，寧遠、安靖、岩州漢民，往往為彼驅入九枝、魚通，防守漢邊。

translations.literal: Since Tang times, when Tibet was strong, Han people of Ningyuan, Anjing, and Yanzhou were often driven by them into Jiuzhi and Yutong to guard the Han frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Since Tang times, when Tibet was strong, Han people of Ningyuan, Anjing, and Yanzhou were often forced into Jiuzhi and Yutong to guard the Han frontier.

sentences.zh: 元初設二萬戶府，仍與盤陀、仁陽置立寨柵，邊民戍守。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Yuan two battalion commands were established, and stockades were still built at Pantuo and Renyang, where frontier people stood guard.
translations.idiomatic: At the Yuan's founding two battalion commands were established and stockades built at Pantuo and Renyang, garrisoned by frontier people.

sentences.zh: 其後各枝率眾攻仁陽等柵。

translations.literal: Thereafter each branch led its followers to attack the stockades at Renyang and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter each branch attacked the Renyang stockades and others.

sentences.zh: 及川蜀兵起，乘勢侵陵雅、邛、嘉等州。

translations.literal: When Sichuan rebel armies rose, they took advantage of the disorder to raid Ya, Qiong, Jia, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: When Sichuan rebel armies rose, they seized the moment to raid Ya, Qiong, Jia, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 洪武十年始隨碉門土酋歸附。

translations.literal: Only in the tenth year of Hongwu did they submit together with the Diaomen tribal chieftain.
translations.idiomatic: They submitted only in Hongwu 10, together with the Diaomen chieftain.

sentences.zh: 岩州、雜道二長官司自國朝設，迨今十有余年，官民仍舊不相統攝。

translations.literal: The two native-official offices of Yanzhou and Zadao have existed since our dynasty established them more than ten years ago, yet officials and people still do not govern one another as before.
translations.idiomatic: The Yanzhou and Zadao native offices have existed more than ten years since our dynasty established them, yet officials and people still do not answer to one another.

sentences.zh: 蓋無統制之司，恣其猖獗，因襲舊弊故也。

translations.literal: This was because there was no governing office to restrain them, allowing their arrogance, continuing old abuses.
translations.idiomatic: Without a governing office to restrain them, old abuses persisted and arrogance ran unchecked.

sentences.zh: 其近而已附者如此，遠而未附者何由而臣服之。

translations.literal: Those nearby who had already submitted were in such a state; how could those far off and not yet submitted be made to yield?
translations.idiomatic: Nearby submitters were already in such disarray; how could distant unsubmitted peoples be brought to yield?

sentences.zh: 且岩州、寧遠等處，乃古之州治。

translations.literal: Moreover Yanzhou, Ningyuan, and other places were ancient prefectural seats.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhou, Ningyuan, and other sites were ancient prefectural seats.

sentences.zh: 苟撥兵戍守，就築城堡，開墾山田，使近者向化而先附，遠者畏威而來歸，西域無事則供我徭役，有事則使之先驅。

translations.literal: If troops were assigned to garrison them, fortresses built on the spot, and hill fields opened for cultivation, then those nearby would turn toward civilization and submit first, those far off would fear our might and come to allegiance; when the western regions were at peace they would supply our corvée labor, and when trouble arose they would serve as our vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: With garrisons, fortresses, and reclaimed fields, the near would submit first and the far would come in fear; in peace they would supply corvée labor, in war serve as vanguard.

sentences.zh: 撫之既久，則皆為我用。

translations.literal: Once pacified for long enough, all would serve our use.
translations.idiomatic: Once governed long enough, all would serve us.

sentences.zh: 如臣之說，其便有六。

translations.literal: As your subject's proposal shows, the advantages number six.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject's proposal offers six advantages.

sentences.zh: 通烏斯藏、朵甘，鎮撫長河西，可拓地四百余里，得番民二千余戶。

translations.literal: Connecting with U-Tsang and Duo-Gan and pacifying Chang River West, the land could be expanded by more than four hundred li and more than two thousand tribal households gained.
translations.idiomatic: Connecting with U-Tsang and Duo-Gan and pacifying Chang River West would expand the frontier by more than four hundred li and gain more than two thousand tribal households.

sentences.zh: 非惟黎、雅保障，蜀亦永無西顧憂。

translations.literal: Not only would Li and Ya be secured, but Shu would forever be free of looking west in worry.
translations.idiomatic: Li and Ya would be secured and Shu would never again worry about its western flank.

sentences.zh: 一也。

translations.literal: This is the first.
translations.idiomatic: First.

sentences.zh: 番民所處老思岡之地，土瘠人繁，專務貿販碉門烏茶、蜀之細布，博易羌貨，以贍其生。

translations.literal: The land of Laosigang where the tribes dwell has poor soil and a dense population; they devote themselves exclusively to trading Diaomen brick tea and fine cloth from Shu, bartering for Qiang goods to support their livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: The tribes of Laosigang live on poor soil amid a dense population; they survive by trading Diaomen brick tea and Sichuan fine cloth for Qiang goods.

sentences.zh: 若於岩州立市，則此輩衣食皆仰給於我，焉敢為非。

translations.literal: If a market is established at Yan Prefecture, then these people's food and clothing would all depend on our supply — how would they dare do wrong?
translations.idiomatic: Establish a market at Yan Prefecture and their food and clothing would depend entirely on us — they would hardly dare make trouble.

sentences.zh: 二也。

translations.literal: This is the second.
translations.idiomatic: Second.

sentences.zh: 以長河西、伯思東、巴獵等八千戶為外番掎角，其勢必固。

translations.literal: With the eight thousand households of Chang River West, Bosidong, Balie, and others as external tribal pincers, their position would necessarily be firm.
translations.idiomatic: Using the eight thousand households of Chang River West, Bosidong, Balie, and the like as external tribal wings would make their position secure.

sentences.zh: 然後招徠遠者，如其不來，使八千戶近為內應，遠為鄉導，此所謂以蠻攻蠻，誠制邊之善道。

translations.literal: Then summon those far away; if they do not come, have the eight thousand households serve as nearby internal allies and distant guides — this is what is called using tribes to attack tribes, truly a good way to control the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Then draw in the distant tribes; if they refuse, the eight thousand households could serve as nearby collaborators and distant guides — using tribes against tribes was the right way to manage the frontier.

sentences.zh: 三也。

translations.literal: This is the third.
translations.idiomatic: Third.

sentences.zh: 天全六番招討司八鄉之民，宜翻蠲其徭役，專令蒸造烏茶，運至岩州，置倉收貯，以易番馬。

translations.literal: The people of the eight townships under the Tianquan Six Tribes Pacification Commission should have their corvée entirely remitted and be ordered exclusively to steam and manufacture brick tea, transport it to Yan Prefecture, establish granaries for storage, and exchange it for tribal horses.
translations.idiomatic: The eight townships of the Tianquan Six Tribes Pacification Commission should be freed from corvée and set exclusively to steaming brick tea for shipment to Yan Prefecture, where storehouses would stock it for horse trade.

sentences.zh: 比之雅州易馬，其利倍之。

translations.literal: Compared with exchanging horses at Ya Prefecture, the profit would be doubled.
translations.idiomatic: Horse trade at Yan Prefecture would yield twice the profit of trade at Ya Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 且於打煎爐原易馬處相去甚近，而價增於彼，則番民如蟻之慕亶，歸市必眾。

translations.literal: Moreover it is very close to the original horse-trading place at Dajianlu, yet prices would be higher there, so the tribes would swarm like ants to mutton fat and the market would necessarily draw a crowd.
translations.idiomatic: It lies very close to the horse market at Dajianlu, yet prices there would be higher — the tribes would swarm like ants to mutton fat and flock to the market.

sentences.zh: 四也。

translations.literal: This is the fourth.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth.

sentences.zh: 岩州既立倉易馬，則番民運茶出境，倍收其稅，其餘物貨至者必多。

translations.literal: Once Yan Prefecture has storehouses for horse trade, tea transported abroad by tribes would be taxed at double rates, and other goods arriving would necessarily increase.
translations.idiomatic: Once Yan Prefecture had storehouses for horse trade, outbound tea could be taxed at double rates and other goods would surely follow in greater volume.

sentences.zh: 又魚通、九枝蠻民所種不陸之田，遞年無征。

translations.literal: Also the dry-field crops planted by the Yutong and Jiuzhi tribes have gone untaxed year after year.
translations.idiomatic: Dry fields farmed by the Yutong and Jiuzhi tribes had also gone untaxed for years.

sentences.zh: 若令歲輸租米，並令軍士開墾大渡河兩岸荒田，亦可供給戍守官軍。

translations.literal: If they are ordered to submit grain rent annually, and troops are set to reclaim wasteland on both banks of the Dadu River, that too could supply the garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Ordering annual grain rent and putting troops to reclaim wasteland on both banks of the Dadu River would also supply the frontier garrison.

sentences.zh: 五也。

translations.literal: This is the fifth.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth.

sentences.zh: 碉門至岩州道路，宜令繕修開拓，以便往來人馬。

translations.literal: The road from Diaomen to Yan Prefecture should be repaired and opened for the passage of men and horses.
translations.idiomatic: The road from Diaomen to Yan Prefecture should be repaired and widened for men and horses.

sentences.zh: 仍量地里遠近，均立郵傳，與黎、雅烽火相應。

translations.literal: According to distance, relay stations should be evenly established to connect with the beacon fires of Li and Ya.
translations.idiomatic: Relay stations should be spaced by distance and linked to the beacon chains of Li and Ya.

sentences.zh: 庶可以防遏亂略，邊境無虞。

translations.literal: Thus disorder could be prevented and the frontier kept secure.
translations.idiomatic: That way raids could be checked and the frontier kept secure.

sentences.zh: 六也。」

translations.literal: This is the sixth.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth.

sentences.zh: 帝從之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 後建昌酋月魯帖木兒叛，長河西諸酋陰附之，失朝貢，太祖怒。

translations.literal: Later the Jianchang chieftain Yue Lu Tie'ermuer rebelled; the chieftains of Chang River West secretly joined him, missed tribute audiences, and the Founding Emperor was angered.
translations.idiomatic: Later Jianchang chieftain Yue Lu Tie'ermuer rebelled; the chieftains of Chang River West secretly sided with him, missed tribute, and the Founding Emperor was enraged.

sentences.zh: 三十年春謂禮部臣曰：「今天下一統，四方萬國皆以時奉貢。

translations.literal: In spring of the thirtieth year he told the Ministry of Rites: "Now the realm is unified and the myriad states of the four quarters all submit tribute on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the thirtieth year he told the Ministry of Rites, "The realm is united and every quarter sends tribute on time.

sentences.zh: 如烏斯藏、尼八剌國其地極遠，猶三歲一朝。

translations.literal: Even U-Tsang and Nepal, whose lands lie extremely far away, still come to court once every three years.
translations.idiomatic: Even U-Tsang and Nepal, at the ends of the earth, still come once every three years.

sentences.zh: 惟打煎爐長河西土酋外附月魯帖木兒、賈哈剌，不臣中國。

translations.literal: Only the native chieftains of Dajianlu and Chang River West have outwardly joined Yue Lu Tie'ermuer and Jahala and do not serve China.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Dajianlu and Chang River West chieftains have openly joined Yue Lu Tie'ermuer and Jahala and refuse allegiance to China.

sentences.zh: 興師討之，鋒刃之下，死者必眾。

translations.literal: If troops are raised to punish them, many must die under the blades.
translations.idiomatic: Raising an army to punish them would mean many deaths under the sword.

sentences.zh: 宜遣人諭其酋。

translations.literal: Envoys should be sent to instruct their chieftains.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys should be sent to warn their chieftains.

sentences.zh: 若聽命來覲，一以恩待，不悛則發兵三十萬，聲罪徂征。」

translations.literal: If they obey and come to audience, treat them entirely with grace; if they do not amend, raise three hundred thousand troops and march to punish their crimes.
translations.idiomatic: If they obey and come to court, treat them with full favor; if they refuse, raise three hundred thousand troops and march to punish their crimes.

sentences.zh: 禮官以帝意為文馳諭之。

translations.literal: The ritual officials drafted the emperor's intent into a dispatch and sent it to them.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials drafted the emperor's message and sent it to them.

sentences.zh: 其酋懼，即遣使入貢謝罪。

translations.literal: Their chieftains feared this and immediately sent envoys with tribute to apologize.
translations.idiomatic: Their chieftains were afraid and at once sent envoys with tribute to apologize.

sentences.zh: 天子赦之，為置長河西魚通寧遠宣慰司，以其酋為宣慰使，自是修貢不絕。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven pardoned them, established the Chang River West Fish Pass Ningyuan Pacification Commission, appointed their chieftain pacification commissioner, and tribute continued thereafter without interruption.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor pardoned them, established the Chang River West Fish Pass Ningyuan Pacification Commission, made their chieftain pacification commissioner, and tribute thereafter never ceased.

sentences.zh: 初，魚通及寧遠、長河西，本各為部，至是始合為一。

translations.literal: At first Yutong, Ningyuan, and Chang River West had each been separate divisions; only now were they merged into one.
translations.idiomatic: Yutong, Ningyuan, and Chang River West had once been separate divisions; only now were they united.

sentences.zh: 永樂十三年，貢使言：「西番無他土產，惟以馬易茶。

translations.literal: Yongle 13, tribute envoys said: "Western tribes have no other local products and trade horses only for tea.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 13 tribute envoys said, "The western tribes produce little else and live by trading horses for tea.

sentences.zh: 近年禁約，生理實艱，乞仍許開中。」

translations.literal: In recent years restrictions have made livelihood truly hard; we beg that tea-for-salt trade be permitted again.
translations.idiomatic: Recent restrictions have made life hard; we beg that the tea-for-salt trade be reopened.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，宣慰使喃哩等二十四人來朝貢馬。

translations.literal: Year 21, pacification commissioner Nanli and twenty-three others came to court presenting horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year pacification commissioner Nanli and twenty-three others came to court with horses.

sentences.zh: 正統二年，喃哩卒，子加八僧嗣。

translations.literal: Zhengtong 2, Nanli died and his son Jia Ba Seng succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong 2 Nanli died and his son Jia Ba Seng succeeded.

sentences.zh: 成化四年申諸番三歲一貢之令，惟長河西仍比歲一貢。

translations.literal: Chenghua 4 reiterated the rule of tribute once every three years for all tribes, but Chang River West still tribute annually.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua 4 the three-year tribute rule was reaffirmed for all tribes, but Chang River West still came every year.

sentences.zh: 六年頒定二年或三年一貢之例，貢使不得過百人。

translations.literal: Year 6 fixed the precedent of tribute every two or three years, with envoys not to exceed one hundred persons.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year tribute every two or three years was fixed and envoys were capped at one hundred.

sentences.zh: 十七年，禮官言：「烏斯藏在長河西之西，長河西在松潘、越巂之南，壤地相接，易於混淆。

translations.literal: Year 17, ritual officials said: "U-Tsang lies west of Chang River West; Chang River West lies south of Songpan and Yuexi; their territories adjoin and are easily confused.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year ritual officials said, "U-Tsang lies west of Chang River West, and Chang River West south of Songpan and Yuexi; their lands adjoin and are easily confused.

sentences.zh: 烏斯藏諸番王例三歲一貢，彼以道險來少，而長河西番僧往往詐為諸王文牒，入貢冒賞。

translations.literal: The tribal kings of U-Tsang tribute once every three years by rule; because the route is dangerous few come, while Chang River West monks often forge the various kings' documents to enter tribute and claim rewards fraudulently.
translations.idiomatic: The U-Tsang kings tribute every three years by rule, but the route is perilous and few come; Chang River West monks often forge royal documents to enter tribute and claim rewards.

sentences.zh: 請給諸番王及長河西、董卜韓胡敕書勘合，邊臣審驗，方許進入，庶免詐偽之弊。

translations.literal: Issue edict letters and tally slips to the tribal kings and to Chang River West and Dongbu Hanhu; frontier officials should examine and verify them before permitting entry, thereby avoiding fraud.
translations.idiomatic: Issue tally-bearing edicts to the tribal kings and to Chang River West and Dongbu Hanhu; frontier officials should verify them before allowing entry and so curb fraud.

sentences.zh: 或道阻，不許補貢。」

translations.literal: If the route is blocked, supplementary tribute should not be permitted.
translations.idiomatic: If the route was blocked, make-up tribute should not be allowed.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 十九年，其部內灌頂國師遣僧徒來貢至千八百人，守臣劾其違制。

translations.literal: Year 19, the Abhiseka State Teacher within their territory sent monk envoys numbering as many as eighteen hundred; frontier officials impeached them for violating regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year the Abhiseka State Teacher in their territory sent as many as eighteen hundred monks; frontier officials impeached the breach of regulations.

sentences.zh: 詔止納五百人，余悉遣還。

translations.literal: An edict ordered acceptance of only five hundred; the rest were all sent back.
translations.idiomatic: An edict accepted only five hundred and sent the rest back.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，禮官言：「長河西以黎州大渡河寇發，連歲失貢，至是補進三貢。

translations.literal: Year 22, ritual officials said: "Because of bandits on the Dadu River at Lizhou, Chang River West missed tribute for successive years and now submits three make-up tributes.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year ritual officials said, "Bandits on the Dadu River at Lizhou had kept Chang River West from tribute for years; they now submit three make-up missions.

sentences.zh: 定制，道梗者不得再補。

translations.literal: By established rule, those blocked on the route may not make up tribute again.
translations.idiomatic: By established rule, those blocked on the route may not make up tribute a second time.

sentences.zh: 但今貢物已至，宜順其情納之，而量減賜賚。」

translations.literal: But since the tribute goods have already arrived, it is fitting to accept them in deference to their feelings, while reducing rewards proportionally.
translations.idiomatic: Since the goods have already arrived, they should be accepted out of courtesy, with rewards reduced accordingly.

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The reply was approved.

sentences.zh: 弘治十二年，禮官言：「長河西及烏期藏諸番，一時並貢，使者至二千八百余人。

translations.literal: Hongzhi 12, ritual officials said: "Chang River West and the tribes of U-Tsang came to tribute at once, with envoys reaching more than twenty-eight hundred persons.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongzhi 12 ritual officials said, "Chang River West and the U-Tsang tribes came to tribute together, with more than twenty-eight hundred envoys.

sentences.zh: 乞諭守臣無濫送。」

translations.literal: They begged that frontier officials be instructed not to send them indiscriminately.
translations.idiomatic: They asked that frontier officials be told not to forward them indiscriminately.

sentences.zh: 亦報可。

translations.literal: Also approved.
translations.idiomatic: That too was approved.

sentences.zh: 然其後來者愈多，卒不能卻。

translations.literal: Yet those who came afterward grew ever more numerous, and in the end they could not be turned away.
translations.idiomatic: Yet later arrivals only increased, and in the end they could not be refused.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖三年定令不得過一千人。

translations.literal: Jiajing 3 fixed the limit at no more than one thousand persons.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 3 the limit was set at one thousand.

sentences.zh: 隆慶三年定五百人全賞、遣八人赴京之制，如闡教諸王。

translations.literal: Longqing 3 fixed the rule of full reward for five hundred and sending eight persons to the capital, as with the Propagation-Teaching kings.
translations.idiomatic: In Longqing 3 the rule was fixed: five hundred fully rewarded and eight sent to the capital, as for the Propagation-Teaching kings.

sentences.zh: 其貢物則珊瑚、氆氌之屬，悉準《闡化王傳》所載。

translations.literal: Their tribute goods — coral, pulu wool, and the like — all followed what is recorded in the Account of the Taming King.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute goods such as coral and pulu wool all followed the Account of the Taming King.

sentences.zh: 諸番貢皆如之。

translations.literal: All tribal tribute followed the same rule.
translations.idiomatic: All tribal tribute followed the same standard.

sentences.zh: 董卜韓胡宣慰司

translations.literal: Dongbu Hanhu Pacification Commission
translations.idiomatic: Dongbu Hanhu Pacification Commission

sentences.zh: 董卜韓胡宣慰司，在四川威州之西，其南與天全六番接。

translations.literal: The Dongbu Hanhu Pacification Commission lay west of Weizhou in Sichuan; to its south it bordered the Tianquan Six Tribes.
translations.idiomatic: The Dongbu Hanhu Pacification Commission lay west of Weizhou in Sichuan, bordering the Tianquan Six Tribes to the south.

sentences.zh: 永樂九年，酋長南葛遣使奉表入朝，貢方物。

translations.literal: Yongle 9, chieftain Nange sent envoys with a memorial to court, presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 9 chieftain Nange sent envoys with a memorial and local products.

sentences.zh: 因言答隆蒙、碉門二招討侵掠鄰境，阻遏道路，請討之。

translations.literal: He also reported that the two pacification commissioners Dalongmeng and Diaomen had raided neighboring territory and blocked the roads, and requested punitive action.
translations.idiomatic: He also reported that the Dalongmeng and Diaomen pacification commissioners were raiding neighbors and blocking the roads, and asked that they be punished.

sentences.zh: 帝不欲用兵，降敕慰諭，使比年一貢，賜金印、冠帶。

translations.literal: The emperor did not wish to use troops, issued a comforting edict, ordered tribute once every two years, and bestowed a gold seal and official cap and sash.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor declined to use force, sent a comforting edict, ordered tribute every other year, and bestowed a gold seal and cap and sash.

sentences.zh: 正統三年奏年老，乞以子克羅俄堅粲代，從之。

translations.literal: Zhengtong 3 he reported old age and begged that his son Keluo'e Jianzan succeed; approved.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong 3 he reported old age and asked that his son Keluo'e Jianzan succeed; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 凶狡不循禮法。

translations.literal: He was fierce and cunning and did not follow ritual and law.
translations.idiomatic: He was violent and cunning and scorned ritual and law.

sentences.zh: 七年乞封王，賜金印，帝不許。

translations.literal: Year 7 he begged enfeoffment as king and a gold seal; the emperor did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he asked to be enfeoffed king and given a gold seal; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 命進秩鎮國將軍、都指揮同知，掌宣慰司事，給之誥命。

translations.literal: He was ordered promoted to Suppress-the-Realm General and vice commander-in-chief, to administer pacification commission affairs, and was given patent of appointment.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Suppress-the-Realm General and vice commander-in-chief, put in charge of the pacification commission, and given a patent of appointment.

sentences.zh: 益恃強，數與雜谷安撫及別思寨安撫饒蛒構怨。

translations.literal: Growing ever more reliant on his strength, he repeatedly feuded with the Zagu pacification commissioner and the Biesizhai pacification commissioner Raoge.
translations.idiomatic: Emboldened by his power, he repeatedly feuded with the Zagu pacification commissioner and Biesizhai pacification commissioner Raoge.

sentences.zh: 十年八月移牒四川守臣，謂：「別思寨本父南葛故地，分畀饒蛒父者。

translations.literal: Year 10, eighth month, he sent a dispatch to Sichuan frontier officials stating: "Biesizhai was originally my father Nange's old territory, allotted to Raoge's father.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, eighth month, he sent a dispatch to Sichuan frontier officials saying, "Biesizhai was originally my father Nange's land, given to Raoge's father.

sentences.zh: 後饒蛒受事，私奏於朝，獲設安撫司。

translations.literal: Later Raoge took office and privately memorialized the court, obtaining establishment of a pacification commission.
translations.idiomatic: Later Raoge took office and privately memorialized the court, winning a pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 邇乃偽為宣慰司印，自稱宣慰使，糾合雜谷諸番，將侵噬己地。

translations.literal: Recently he forged a pacification commission seal, styled himself pacification commissioner, rallied the Zagu tribes, and was about to encroach on my territory.
translations.idiomatic: Recently he forged a pacification commission seal, styled himself pacification commissioner, rallied the Zagu tribes, and was about to seize my land.

sentences.zh: 已拘執饒蛒，追出偽印，用番俗法剜去兩目。

translations.literal: I have already seized Raoge, recovered the forged seal, and by tribal custom gouged out both his eyes.
translations.idiomatic: I have already seized Raoge, recovered the forged seal, and by tribal custom put out both his eyes.

sentences.zh: 謹以狀聞。」

translations.literal: Respectfully reporting this by petition.
translations.idiomatic: I respectfully report this.

sentences.zh: 守臣上其事。

translations.literal: The frontier officials reported the matter upward.
translations.idiomatic: The frontier officials reported the matter.

sentences.zh: 帝遣使齎敕責其專擅，令與使臣推擇饒蛒族人為安撫，仍轄其土地，且送還饒蛒，養之終身。

translations.literal: The emperor sent an envoy bearing an edict rebuking his unauthorized action, ordering him with the envoy to select a member of Raoge's clan as pacification commissioner still governing that land, and moreover to return Raoge and support him for life.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent an envoy with an edict rebuking his overreach, ordering him with the envoy to choose a member of Raoge's clan as pacification commissioner over that land, return Raoge, and support him for life.

sentences.zh: 十三年十月，四川巡按張洪等奏：「近接董卜宣慰文牒言：『雜谷故安撫阿票小妻毒殺其夫及子，又賄威州千戶唐泰誣己謀叛。

translations.literal: Zhengtong 13, tenth month, Sichuan touring censor Zhang Hong and others memorialized: "We have lately received a dispatch from the Dongbu pacification commissioner stating: 'The former Zagu pacification commissioner A'a's junior wife poisoned her husband and son, and also bribed Weizhou battalion commander Tang Tai to falsely accuse me of plotting rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong 13, tenth month, Sichuan touring censor Zhang Hong and others memorialized: "We have lately received a dispatch from the Dongbu pacification commissioner saying, 'The former Zagu pacification commissioner A'a's junior wife poisoned her husband and son, and bribed Weizhou battalion commander Tang Tai to accuse me of rebellion.

sentences.zh: 今備物進貢，欲從銅門山西開山通道，乞官軍於日駐迓之。』

translations.literal: I have now prepared goods for tribute and wish to open a mountain route west of Tongmen Mountain; I beg that official troops be stationed at Rizhu to escort us.
translations.idiomatic: I have prepared tribute goods and wish to open a route west of Tongmen Mountain; I beg that official troops be posted at Rizhu to escort us.

sentences.zh: 臣等竊以雜谷內聯威州、保縣，外鄰董卜韓胡。

translations.literal: We privately consider that Zagu links internally with Weizhou and Baoxian and borders Dongbu Hanhu externally.
translations.idiomatic: We consider that Zagu links internally with Weizhou and Baoxian and borders Dongbu Hanhu externally.

sentences.zh: 雜谷力弱，欲抗董卜，實倚重於威、保。

translations.literal: Zagu is weak; to resist Dongbu it truly relies on Weizhou and Baoxian.
translations.idiomatic: Zagu is weak; to resist Dongbu it relies on Weizhou and Baoxian.

sentences.zh: 董卜勢強，欲通威、保，卻受阻於雜谷。

translations.literal: Dongbu is strong and wishes to reach Weizhou and Baoxian, yet is blocked by Zagu.
translations.idiomatic: Dongbu is strong and wants access to Weizhou and Baoxian, but Zagu stands in the way.

sentences.zh: 以此仇殺，素不相能。

translations.literal: Because of this feud they have long been incompatible.
translations.idiomatic: Long-standing feuds have kept them at odds.

sentences.zh: 銅門及日駐諸寨，乃雜谷、威、保要害地。

translations.literal: Tongmen and the forts at Rizhu and elsewhere are strategic ground for Zagu, Weizhou, and Baoxian.
translations.idiomatic: Tongmen and the Rizhu forts are strategic ground for Zagu, Weizhou, and Baoxian.

sentences.zh: 董卜欺雜谷妻寡子弱，瞰我軍遠征麓川，假進貢之名，欲別開道路，意在吞滅雜谷，扌冓陷唐泰。

translations.literal: Dongbu, taking advantage of Zagu's widow and weak son while our army campaigns far away in Lucuan, under pretense of tribute wishes to open a separate route, intending to swallow Zagu and frame Tang Tai.
translations.idiomatic: Dongbu, seeing Zagu weakened by widowhood and a young heir while our army is far away in Lucuan, uses tribute as a pretext to open a new route, intending to swallow Zagu and frame Tang Tai.

sentences.zh: 所請不可許。」

translations.literal: The request must not be granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request must not be granted.

sentences.zh: 乃下都御史寇深等計度，其議迄不行。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to Censor-in-Chief Kou Shen and others for deliberation, but the proposal was never carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was sent to Censor-in-Chief Kou Shen and others for review, but the proposal was never adopted.

sentences.zh: 時董卜比歲入貢，所遣僧徒強悍不法，多攜私物，強索舟車，騷擾道途，詈辱長吏。

translations.literal: At that time Dongbu came to tribute annually; the monks he sent were fierce and lawless, often carrying private goods, forcibly demanding boats and carts, harassing the roads, and reviling senior officials.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Dongbu tribute came every year; his monks were violent and lawless, often carrying private goods, demanding boats and carts by force, harassing the roads, and reviling senior officials.

sentences.zh: 天子聞而惡之，景泰元年賜敕切責。

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven heard and detested this; in Jingtai 1 an edict sharply rebuked him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor heard and was disgusted; in Jingtai 1 an edict sharply rebuked him.

sentences.zh: 尋侵奪雜谷及達思蠻長官司地，掠其人畜，守臣不能制。

translations.literal: Soon he seized the lands of Zagu and the Dasiman Headman Office and plundered people and livestock; frontier officials could not control him.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he seized Zagu and Dasiman Headman Office lands and plundered people and livestock; frontier officials could not stop him.

sentences.zh: 三年二月朝議獎其入貢勤誠，進秩都指揮使，令還二司侵地及所掠人民。

translations.literal: Second month, Jingtai 3, court deliberation rewarded his diligent tribute, promoted him to commander-in-chief, and ordered return of the seized lands of the two commissions and the people plundered.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Jingtai 3 the court rewarded his diligent tribute, promoted him to commander-in-chief, and ordered return of the two commissions' seized lands and captives.

sentences.zh: 其酋即奉命，惟舊維州之地尚為所據。

translations.literal: The chieftain obeyed at once, but old Weizhou territory was still held by him.
translations.idiomatic: The chieftain obeyed, but old Weizhou territory remained in his hands.

sentences.zh: 俄饋四川巡撫李匡銀ＤＮ、金珀，求《御制大誥》、《周易》、《尚書》、《毛詩》、《小學》、《方輿勝覽》、《成都記》諸書。

translations.literal: Soon he presented Sichuan grand coordinator Li Kuang with silver ingots and gold amber, requesting the Imperially Composed Great Admonitions, the Book of Changes, the Book of Documents, the Mao Classic of Poetry, the Elementary Learning, the Comprehensive Gazetteer of the Empire, the Record of Chengdu, and other books.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he gave Sichuan grand coordinator Li Kuang silver ingots and gold amber, requesting the Imperially Composed Great Admonitions, the Book of Changes, the Book of Documents, the Mao Classic of Poetry, the Elementary Learning, the Comprehensive Gazetteer of the Empire, the Record of Chengdu, and other books.

sentences.zh: 匡聞之於朝，因言：「唐時吐蕃求《毛詩》、《春秋》。

translations.literal: Kuang reported to court and said: "In Tang times Tibet requested the Mao Classic of Poetry and the Spring and Autumn Annals.
translations.idiomatic: Kuang reported to court and said, "In Tang times Tibet asked for the Mao Classic of Poetry and the Spring and Autumn Annals.

sentences.zh: 於休烈謂，予之以書，使知權謀，愈生變詐，非中國之利。

translations.literal: Yu Xiulie said that granting books would teach them stratagem and breed ever more fraud — not to China's benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Xiulie argued that giving them books would teach stratagem and breed fraud — not to China's benefit.

sentences.zh: 裴光廷謂，吐蕃久叛新服，因其有表，賜以《詩》、《書》，俾漸陶聲教，化流無外。

translations.literal: Pei Guangting said Tibet had long rebelled and was newly subdued; since they had submitted a memorial, bestowing the Classic of Poetry and Book of Documents would gradually imbue them with civilizing influence until transformation spread beyond the borders.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Guangting argued that Tibet had long rebelled and was newly subdued; since they had petitioned, bestowing the Classic of Poetry and Book of Documents would gradually spread civilization beyond the borders.

sentences.zh: 休烈徒知書有權略變詐，不知忠信禮義皆從書出。

translations.literal: Xiulie knew only that books contain stratagem and fraud, not that loyalty, faith, propriety, and righteousness all flow from books.
translations.idiomatic: Xiulie saw only stratagem and fraud in books, not that loyalty, faith, propriety, and righteousness all come from them.

sentences.zh: 明皇從之。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming followed Guangting.

sentences.zh: 今茲所求，臣以為予之便。

translations.literal: What is requested now, your subject believes, should be granted.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject believes what is requested now should be granted.

sentences.zh: 不然彼因貢使市之書肆，甚不為難。

translations.literal: Otherwise they could easily obtain them through tribute envoys at bookshops.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise their tribute envoys could buy them easily at bookshops.

sentences.zh: 惟《方輿勝覽》、《成都記》，形勝關塞所具，不可概予。」

translations.literal: Only the Comprehensive Gazetteer of the Empire and the Record of Chengdu, which detail strategic terrain and passes, must not be given indiscriminately.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Comprehensive Gazetteer of the Empire and the Record of Chengdu, which map strategic terrain and passes, should not be given freely.

sentences.zh: 帝如其言。

translations.literal: The emperor acted as he advised.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 尋以其還侵地，賜敕獎勵。

translations.literal: Soon, because he returned the seized lands, an edict of commendation was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, because he returned the seized lands, a commendatory edict was issued.

sentences.zh: 六年，兵部尚書于謙等奏其僭稱蠻王，窺伺巴，蜀，所上奏章語多不遜，且招集群番，大治戎器，悖逆日彰，不可不慮，宜敕守臣預為戒備，從之。
