translations.literal: Year 6, Minister of War Yu Qian and others memorialized that he had arrogantly styled himself tribal king, was eyeing Ba and Shu, used insolent language in memorials, was gathering tribes and extensively preparing weapons — his rebelliousness growing daily and not to be ignored; frontier officials should be instructed to prepare defenses in advance. Approved.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Minister of War Yu Qian and others memorialized that he had styled himself tribal king, was eyeing Ba-Shu, wrote insolently in memorials, was gathering tribes and arming heavily — his defiance growing daily; frontier officials should prepare defenses in advance. The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 克羅俄堅粲死，子答刂思堅粲藏卜遣使來貢，命為都指揮同知，掌宣慰司事。

translations.literal: Keluo'e Jianzan died; his son Dalisi Jianzangzangbu sent envoys to offer tribute and was appointed vice commander-in-chief, directing the pacification commissioner's office.
translations.idiomatic: When Keluo'e Jianzan died, his son Dalisi Jianzangzangbu sent tribute and was appointed vice commander-in-chief to head the pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 天順元年遣使入貢，乞封王。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianshun he sent envoys to offer tribute and begged enfeoffment as king.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianshun 1 he sent tribute and asked to be enfeoffed as king.

sentences.zh: 命如其父官，進秩都指揮使，仍掌宣慰司事。

translations.literal: He was ordered to hold his father's office, promoted to commander-in-chief, and still directed the pacification commissioner's office.
translations.idiomatic: He was given his father's post, promoted to commander-in-chief, and continued to head the pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 成化五年，四川三司奏：「保縣僻處極邊，永樂五年特設雜谷安撫司，令撫輯舊維州諸處蠻塞。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chenghua the three offices of Sichuan memorialized: "Baoxian lies in a remote border region; in the fifth year of Yongle the Zagu Pacification Commission was specially established to soothe the old Weizhou barbarian stockades.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua 5 the Sichuan provincial offices reported, "Baoxian lies on the outer frontier; in Yongle 5 the Zagu Pacification Commission was set up to govern the old Weizhou tribal stockades.

sentences.zh: 後與董卜構兵，維州諸地俱為侵奪，貢道阻絕。

translations.literal: Later they fought with Dongbu; the Weizhou territories were all seized, and the tribute route was cut off.
translations.idiomatic: Later war with Dongbu seized the Weizhou lands and blocked the tribute route.

sentences.zh: 今雜谷恢復故疆，將遣使來貢，不知貢期，未敢擅遣。」

translations.literal: Now Zagu has recovered its former territory and will send envoys to offer tribute, but the tribute schedule is unknown and they dare not send them on their own authority.
translations.idiomatic: Zagu has now recovered its territory and wishes to send tribute, but the schedule is unclear and they dare not dispatch envoys without orders.

sentences.zh: 帝從禮官言，許以三年為期。

translations.literal: The emperor followed the ritual officials' advice and allowed a three-year interval.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor followed the ritual officials and set a three-year interval.

sentences.zh: 四年申諸番三年一貢之例，惟董卜許比年一貢。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the three-year tribute rule was proclaimed for all tribes; only Dongbu was allowed annual tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the three-year tribute rule was applied to all tribes, but Dongbu alone was permitted annual missions.

sentences.zh: 六年，答刂巴堅粲藏卜卒，子綽吾結言千嗣為都指揮使。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Daliba Jianzangzangbu died; his son Chuowu Jieyanqian succeeded as commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Daliba Jianzangzangbu died and his son Chuowu Jieyanqian succeeded as commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 弘治三年卒，子日墨答刂思巴旺丹巴藏卜遣國師貢珊瑚樹、氆氌、甲胄諸物，請嗣父職，許之，賜誥命、敕書、彩幣。

translations.literal: He died in the third year of Hongzhi; his son Rimodalisibawangdanbazangbu sent a state preceptor with tribute of coral trees, woolens, armor, and other goods, requesting succession to his father's post; this was granted, and patent, imperial letter, and patterned silks were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Hongzhi 3; his son Rimodalisibawangdanbazangbu sent a state preceptor with coral trees, woolens, armor, and other tribute, seeking to succeed his father; the request was granted with patent, imperial letter, and silks.

sentences.zh: 九年卒，子喃呆請襲，亦遣國師貢方物，詔授以父官。

translations.literal: He died in the ninth year; his son Nandai asked to succeed and also sent a state preceptor with local products; an edict granted his father's office.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the ninth year; his son Nandai sought succession and sent a state preceptor with tribute; an edict granted his father's rank.

sentences.zh: 卒，子容中短竹襲。

translations.literal: He died and his son Rongzhongduanzhu succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was succeeded by his son Rongzhongduanzhu.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二年再定令貢使不得過千人，其所隸別思寨及加渴瓦寺別貢。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiajing the rule was set again that tribute envoys must not exceed a thousand; the subordinate Biesizhai and Jiakewa Monastery were to offer tribute separately.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 2 fixed the envoy limit at a thousand; Biesizhai and Jiakewa Monastery under its jurisdiction sent separate tribute.

sentences.zh: 隆慶二年，董卜及別思寨貢使多至千七百余人，命予半賞，遣八人赴京，為定制。

translations.literal: In the second year of Longqing, Dongbu and Biesizhai envoys numbered more than seventeen hundred; an order gave half rewards and sent eight to the capital, which became the fixed rule.
translations.idiomatic: In Longqing 2 Dongbu and Biesizhai sent over seventeen hundred envoys; half rewards were ordered and only eight sent to the capital, establishing the permanent rule.

sentences.zh: 迄萬曆後，朝貢不替。

translations.literal: Down to after Wanli, court tribute did not cease.
translations.idiomatic: Court tribute continued without break through the Wanli era and after.
